description: DeepSeek R1 triggers Sputnik moment and $600B Nvidia crash. Stargate bets $500B on US compute. Agents (Operator, Deep Research, Codex), GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5/3 and open-weights (Qwen3, Kimi K2, gpt-oss) mature. Regulation splits: EU enforces, California passes SB 53, US accelerates.

events.title: DeepSeek-R1 open reasoning shock
events.summary: DeepSeek-AI released R1: 671B MoE (37B active), MIT license, trained via large-scale RL without SFT (R1-Zero) plus cold-start RL. Matches OpenAI o1 on math, code and reasoning at ~1/45th claimed training cost. Paper arXiv:2501.12948. Six distilled Qwen and Llama variants run on consumer GPUs. Andreessen calls it AI's Sputnik moment.
events.significance: Efficiency shock that crashes Nvidia and forces US labs to cut prices.

events.title: Google Antigravity public preview (agent-first dev platform)
events.summary: Launched alongside Gemini 3 Pro: Antigravity public preview, free on Windows, Mac and Linux. Agent-first platform with an Editor view (IDE with tab completions, commands, side-panel agent) plus a Manager surface to spawn and orchestrate multiple async agents. Agents autonomously plan, execute and verify across editor, terminal and browser (browser control included), reporting back with artifacts like task lists, plans, screenshots and recordings. Generous Gemini 3 Pro limits; millions of developers adopted it, 2.0 standalone app May 19 2026, Enterprise tier Aug 2026.
events.significance: Google's agent-first IDE; makes manager-of-agents the default development workflow.
